title: Product launch page
summary: Build a responsive product page that makes compatibility and repair information easy to find.
originNote: A conventional product-launch control with a real tension between persuasion and decision clarity.

setup.instructions: Mount the supplied product packet and validator in the fresh workspace. Produce a self-contained static website with no network dependencies. Copy or embed every runtime input the artifact needs into the allowed published output paths; fixtures/ and validation/ are not shipped with the Dish.

turns.content: Read fixtures/product.json and build the complete responsive launch page as index.html with any local CSS or JavaScript it needs. Use every supplied product, mount, compatibility, runtime, repair, and action fact accurately; do not invent testimonials, reviews, discounts, awards, environmental claims, or other product facts. Make the object desirable while keeping mounting limits, runtime, and repairability in the main decision path. Give the page a chosen visual point of view rather than a generic SaaS landing-page treatment. Make the two mounting modes easy to compare without using a table or feature-grid facsimile. It must work at 390px and 1440px, use semantic HTML, support keyboard navigation, and expose a visible keyboard focus state. Do not explain the design instead of building it.

checks.description: The entry and any shipped JavaScript or stylesheet assets are nonempty, and JavaScript parses as modules.
At 390px and 1440px, inspect whether desire and decision clarity coexist and whether the mounting modes compare naturally without becoming a table.
